milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The cobblestone path is on the ground directly ahead of spawn at (0,0,3). Max_distance=3 ensures the player has walked forward onto/near the path rather than triggering instantly at spawn. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the cobblestone. This is the entry-point milestone that gates all subsequent tasks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The sandstone_wall pillar blocks are at the entrance of the left sandstone building at (-3,1,5). Max_distance=5 ensures the player has navigated to the left fork of the cobblestone path and is close enough to observe the distinctive wall pillars. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the sandstone_wall blocks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The cartography_table is placed inside the right oak planks building at (4,0,7). Max_distance=5 ensures the player has navigated to the right fork and entered or is at the entrance of the oak building. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the cartography_table.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The green_bed is in the back stone_bricks room with its foot at (0,0,10) and head at (0,0,11). Max_distance=4 ensures the player has actually entered or is at the doorway of the back room (which requires passing through the scene). Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the green_bed. The DAG enforces that sandstone_wall and cartography_table milestones must be completed first.
